headline: Wardens Take Nine of Ten Posts in Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Callahan's Passage yields the chief tidings of this edition: the Wardens now hold nine of its ten posts, five flags having fallen to them within the day, and the fighting about The Latch, Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage has cost upwards of eight thousand casualties on each side in twenty-four hours. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's costliest ground, its cumulative toll now past two hundred eighteen thousand on one side and two hundred fifty-two thousand on the other, with twenty-five base actions in the latest day at Frostmarch, Shattered Advance and Huntsfort. Stlican Shelf's seesaw stands three Warden posts to six Colonial, with Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost again the busiest grounds; Stonecradle's contest rests at two to seven, and Linn Mercy bleeds heavily about Lathair. The Nevish Line, ablaze at our last writing, has been silent since evening despite twenty actions in its day's ledger; Fisherman's Row and Viper Pit likewise lie quiet, and Mooring County's losses run deep without a post changing hands. It is day 448; thirty-four victory towns will decide the issue, and no victor is named.
